newsitem.title: USA: Central Newspapers November revenues up.
newsitem.headline: Central Newspapers November revenues up.

text.p: Central Newspapers Inc said Wednesday its revenues increased 10 percent for the four weeks ended November 24, 1996 compared with the four weeks ended November 19, 1995.
Full run-of-press advertising linage for the fiscal month was up 3.4 percent compared with the prior year.
It said revenues in November advanced to $53.0 million from $48.2 million.
Year to date, total revenues increased 8.5 percent to $553.2 million from $509.8 million.
Central Newspapers said 1996 amounts include $1.4 million for the four-week period and $13.2 million year to date of revenues from the acquiition of McCormick and Co Inc in March 1996.
Central Newspapers is a media company that publishes daily and weekly newspapers.
